name: MusicBrainz
what_it_has: Real genre nasheed (MBID e0ddc3bf-1fa8-44ac-89ae-e3306cdf8541), subgenre of islamic religious music. Tags present: nasheed, naat, nasyid, ilahi, islamic, muslim. Coverage is tiny: only 6 recordings tagged nasheed at time of research.
access_method: REST /ws/2 with fmt=json; XML or JSON; data dumps and Live Data Feed
limits_and_auth: 1 request/second; meaningful User-Agent required; no key for reads
legal_note: Core data CC0. Supplementary data and Live Data Feed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 — commercial reuse needs a MetaBrainz licence.
note: Best legal base for a metadata backbone, despite thin coverage

name: MusicBrainz genre vocabulary
what_it_has: Full genre and tag list for building your own taxonomy
limits_and_auth: 1 req/sec
legal_note: CC0
note: Use to normalise your own tag list

name: Discogs
what_it_has: Best physical-release data: label, catalogue number, country, year, credits, barcode. No usable Nasheed style — Arabic and Islamic releases sit under Folk, World and Country with blank styles.
limits_and_auth: 25 req/min unauthenticated; 60/min authenticated; search requires a token
legal_note: User-contributed; API terms restrict bulk mirroring and image reuse. Index, do not republish wholesale.
note: Enrich album metadata here; never filter by style

name: Last.fm
what_it_has: Best discovery layer in this niche. Real listener tags with artist and track lists: nasheed, anasheed, nasyid, ilahi.
limits_and_auth: No published quota; error 29 means rate-limited. Throttle hard.
legal_note: Commercial or research use requires contacting Last.fm. Do not redistribute tag data wholesale.
note: Use to expand candidates, then verify each artist's own tags

name: Deezer
what_it_has: Clean commercial metadata for digitally distributed nasheed artists, plus 30-second previews
access_method: REST api.deezer.com, no key for catalogue reads
limits_and_auth: q parameter mandatory; regional availability applies
legal_note: 30-second extracts only; never expose full stream URLs; offline storage of audio forbidden.
note: Link-out and preview layer only

name: Spotify
what_it_has: Artist-level genres array, ISRC and UPC, popularity, market availability
limits_and_auth: Search limit default 5, max 10 since Feb 2026; developer app plus Premium account
legal_note: Developer Terms forbid storing, aggregating or building databases of Spotify content; no scraping; no ML training; apps may not be associated with religious causes. Use widgets and link-out only.
note: Do not build the database from Spotify responses

name: YouTube Data API
what_it_has: The de facto home of nasheed: official artist channels, label channels, topic channels
example_query: GET /search?part=snippet&q=nasheed&type=channel&maxResults=50 and playlistItems on the uploads playlist
limits_and_auth: 100 search.list calls/day plus 10,000 units/day overall
legal_note: No downloading, caching or storing audiovisual content; no aggregating API data; non-authorized data must be refreshed or deleted within 30 days; no scraping; show YouTube branding.
note: Store videoId, channelId and a last-verified date; refresh monthly

name: Internet Archive
what_it_has: Thousands of user-uploaded nasheed items; collections include Community Audio and Nasheed Music Videos. Advanced search for mediatype:audio AND nasheed returns 5,819 hits.
access_method: Advanced Search API, Scrape API, per-item metadata API
limits_and_auth: Sorted paging capped at 10,000 results; use the scrape endpoint with a cursor beyond that
legal_note: Per-item licences only. Many items are re-uploads with no rights statement; a CC tag applied by an uploader does not prove the rights holder licensed it. A meaningful share of items is extremist propaganda — filter hard.
note: Only include items with an explicit licence and a clean content check

name: Wikimedia Commons
what_it_has: Almost no nasheed audio: filetype:audio nasheed returns 3 hits, only one genuine
limits_and_auth: None for reads; follow API etiquette
legal_note: Per-file licence (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, PD); attribute per file.
note: Tiny but legally clean for the one or two usable files

name: Wikidata
what_it_has: Genre item Q783874 (nasheed), aliases ilahija and nasyid, linked to MusicBrainz; artists carry genre = nasheed
example_query: SELECT ?a ?aLabel WHERE { ?a wdt:P136 wd:Q783874 . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,ar,ms,id,tr". } } LIMIT 2000
limits_and_auth: No auth; 60-second query timeout; no huge unbounded queries
legal_note: Structured data CC0; Wikipedia text CC BY-SA 4.0
note: Endpoint is migrating to v2 URLs in 2026-27; pin and monitor

name: Wikipedia categories
what_it_has: Category:Nasheed singers; Category:Performers of Islamic music with subcategories for Malaysian nasheed groups, Awakening artists, Pakistani performers, maddahs
limits_and_auth: None for reads
legal_note: Text CC BY-SA 4.0
note: Walk subcategories with cmtype=subcat

name: Rate Your Music
what_it_has: Nasheed genre page with releases and ratings; linked from MusicBrainz
limits_and_auth: Scraping discouraged
legal_note: Editorial content; do not scrape or republish
note: Manual cross-check only

name: Hugging Face — Qur'an recitation datasets
what_it_has: Large reciter corpora (everyayah, tadabur with 600+ reciters, quran-md-ayahs). Useful for the qari half of the library, not for nasheed.
limits_and_auth: Per-dataset gating
legal_note: Mixed: CC BY-NC 4.0, Apache-2.0 and custom. Check each card before redistribution.
note: Recitation only; no nasheed dataset of comparable quality exists

name: GitHub nasheed collections
what_it_has: Two re-upload collections: Nasheeds/collection (~100 MP3s) and iamaanahmad/NasheedCollection (115+ MP3s plus audio_catalog.json metadata)
limits_and_auth: None
legal_note: No clear licence; a repo licence cannot grant rights the uploader never had. Use as a seed list of titles, not as an audio source.
note: Metadata seed only

name: NoCopyrightNasheeds
what_it_has: 2,400+ nasheeds from 230+ artists under a copyright-free licence model
limits_and_auth: Paid tiers ($1.99-11.99/month, $299 lifetime)
legal_note: Audio reusable with credit; their YouTube videos remain copyrighted; non-YouTube use needs their licence.
note: The cleanest bulk audio source for a legitimately hosted subset

name: Smithsonian Folkways
what_it_has: Archival East African kasida, e.g. Music of the Waswahili of Lamu Vol.2 (1985)
limits_and_auth: Purchase for audio
legal_note: Label licensing; liner notes are a strong citation source
note: Best documented Swahili devotional recording

name: HMML — Music and Nasheeds from West Africa
what_it_has: Manuscript-linked qasida and Mawlid recordings from Timbuktu and Senegal
legal_note: Institutional archive; cite, do not republish
note: The only serious documentation of the Sahel layer

name: HDtracks-free CC sources (Netlabels, FMA, Jamendo)
what_it_has: Creative Commons music where the uploader is the rights holder
limits_and_auth: Varies
legal_note: CC0 or CC BY only for safe reuse; NC blocks ad-supported use; ND blocks syncing to video
note: Use to seed a legally clean a cappella subset

name: Assajda / Assabile
what_it_has: Country-tagged nasheed catalogue: a 36-munshid index on Assajda and a parallel Assabile catalogue, each artist page carrying a track count, Arabic and Latin names and an album list.
access_method: Web only (no public API); artist index at /en/anasheed, one page per munshid
limits_and_auth: robots.txt disallows /api/, /download/, /*/ajax/, /*/queue/ and /*/search — so the index and artist pages are readable but nothing behind those paths is.
legal_note: Proprietary portal hosting its own audio. Use for discovery and cross-checking, link out rather than copy, and never mirror tracks.
note: Indexes 36 munshids and confirmed 28 existing records; strongest source for the Moroccan roster

name: Islamic adhan and recitation APIs
what_it_has: Adhan audio, prayer times, reciter lists
limits_and_auth: Free tier
legal_note: Check each provider; adhan audio is not nasheed and has separate rights
note: Only relevant if you extend into adhan and tilawa

name: Samaa Network (play.samaanetwork.net)
what_it_has: Large Arabic-language nasheed portal: 500+ munshid and group pages with full track listings, bilingual Arabic/Latin titles, playlists and a WordPress back end.
access_method: Web only. Paginate https://play.samaanetwork.net/artists/page/{n}/ and follow each card to its numeric permalink, which is the artist page.
limits_and_auth: The download_artist post type is not exposed at /wp-json/wp/v2/, and download_artist-sitemap.xml lists /artists/{slug}/ URLs that 404 — crawl the paginated listing instead, at a polite rate.
legal_note: A distribution platform, not a rights holder. Index the metadata and link out; do not mirror audio.
note: Best bilingual name source in the niche; only 24 of its 576 listed acts were already in this library
